subject: SCIENCE
title: Pushes and Pulls
introduction: A force is a push or pull; changes in motion depend on combined forces and constraints. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: A push or a pull on something.
To move something away from you.
To bring something closer to you.
